cues: Keeping favorite novels beside an armchair makes choosing an evening read effortless.
Visible spines help a student find assigned texts quickly before a study session.
Grouping cookbooks together makes weeknight recipe searches faster and inspires new meals.
Morning sunlight warmed the windowsill while rain tapped softly against the glass.
After practice, the goalkeeper rinsed muddy gloves and filled a bottle with water.
At the orchard, bees moved between blossoms as the first apples began forming.
